reviews.name: Kay L
reviews.title: PERFECT COSTA RICA EXPERIENCE
reviews.text: We just returned from a once in a lifetime 10 day family vacation to Costa Rica. 6 adults and 6 children, ages 4-14. We used Costa Rica Drivers for our entire experience...transport and excursions. Setting up the actual plan for our stay was effortless because of Leo who worked closely with us to make sure we had the best adventures and tours possible. Our driver/guide, Pablo was absolutely wonderful. He was a wealth of information and enriched every aspect of our trip. Every excursion was excellent and the cost was less than had I set everything up myself. The vehicles were in excellent condition and we felt extremely safe in every aspect of our experience. We will never forget the magical time we had there.

reviews.name: mjc258
reviews.title: Private guide / driver only way to go
reviews.text: We started our trip using Leo to set things up. Our friends had used him many years ago and weren’t sure he was still in the business. We spoke to Leo and right away we knew we could work with him. His suggestions saved us from wasting three travel days of our ten day trip just going from one location to another. We were able to have excursions on our travel days as opposed to just getting transfers from one spot to another. Our guide / driver was Roy and he was so knowledgeable about the whole country. Any subject we bought up he was able to expound on and make it interesting. Roy pointed out things in the forest that we would have never found. Roy was easygoing and flexible with what we wanted to do. He also has a good sense of humor. Our days were full and fun thanks to both Leo and Roy.

tours.title: Río Celeste Waterfall
tours.lead: Chase the impossible blue of Costa Rica's most famous waterfall.
overview: Deep inside Tenorio Volcano National Park, two ordinary rivers meet and turn a surreal shade of turquoise, a natural phenomenon found in only a handful of places on Earth.

On this full-day escape you'll hike through pristine rainforest to the legendary Río Celeste Waterfall, pass steaming volcanic vents and bubbling blue lagoons, and learn the science and folklore behind the color from your naturalist guide. It's nature, photography, and pure wonder in one unforgettable day.
highlights: Scenic drive to Tenorio Volcano National Park
Guided rainforest hike to the waterfall, natural pools & volcanic features
steps: Scenic drive to Tenorio Volcano National Park
Guided rainforest hike to the waterfall, natural pools & volcanic features
tours.bring: Hiking shoes, rain jacket, water, sunscreen, camera, cash for extras.

tours.title: White Water Rafting
tours.lead: Paddle through jungle rapids on one of Costa Rica's best rivers.
overview: Grab a paddle and hit the whitewater. Class II and III rapids on the Balsa or Sarapiquí River wind through lush rainforest canyons, with calm stretches to soak in the scenery and spot toucans, herons and monkeys along the banks.
Certified guides lead every raft, so first-timers and thrill-seekers alike get the perfect balance of adrenaline and safety. A riverside snack caps off the ride.
highlights: The river run through rapids and calm pools
steps: The river run through rapids and calm pools
tours.bring: Quick-dry clothes, secured sandals or water shoes, sunscreen, a change of clothes, waterproof camera.

tours.title: Sloth Tour – Rain Forest Walk
tours.lead: Meet Costa Rica's most beloved local, the sloth, in the wild.
overview: Slow down and see the rainforest through a naturalist's eyes. On this gentle guided walk you'll search the canopy for two- and three-toed sloths in their natural habitat, plus the toucans, frogs, lizards, and colorful birds that share their world.
Our guides carry professional scopes so you get a close-up look and that perfect photo. Easy pace, big rewards, ideal for families.
highlights: Guided walk through private rainforest trails
steps: Guided walk through private rainforest trails
tours.bring: Comfortable walking shoes, insect repellent, camera, water.

tours.title: Arenal Hanging Bridges
tours.lead: Walk the treetops on suspended bridges above the rainforest.
overview: Experience the rainforest from a whole new angle, eye-level with the canopy. A network of trails and suspension bridges carries you over ravines and through primary forest, with sweeping views of the Arenal Volcano along the way.
Your guide reveals the wildlife most visitors miss: birds, snakes, frogs, and the intricate ecosystem thriving above and below you. Awe-inspiring and accessible for all ages.
highlights: Guided walk across the hanging bridges and forest trails
steps: Guided walk across the hanging bridges and forest trails
tours.bring: Walking shoes, rain jacket, camera, water.

tours.title: Arenal Volcano Hike
tours.lead: Hike the lava trails at the foot of an iconic volcano.
overview: Stand in the shadow of one of the world's most perfectly shaped volcanoes. This guided hike follows trails across old lava flows from Arenal's active years, through regenerating forest alive with wildlife, to viewpoints that frame the volcano and Lake Arenal.
Your guide brings the landscape to life with the geology, history and ecology of the volcano and the forest around it.
highlights: Short drive to the volcano trails
Guided hike across lava fields and rainforest trails
steps: Short drive to the volcano trails
Guided hike across lava fields and rainforest trails
tours.bring: Hiking shoes, hat, sunscreen, rain jacket, water, camera.

tours.title: Jungle River Safari Float
tours.lead: Drift downriver and let the wildlife come to you.
overview: Trade the trail for the water on this peaceful float down a wildlife-rich river. From a safe, stable boat you'll glide past riverbanks teeming with life, caimans, iguanas, monkeys, sloths, and dozens of bird species, while your naturalist guide points out creatures you'd never spot on your own.
No paddling, no rapids, just nature at its own gentle pace. Perfect for families and photographers.

tours.title: Jungle Night Walk
tours.lead: The rainforest wakes up when the sun goes down.
overview: After dark the forest around La Fortuna belongs to a different crowd. With a naturalist guide and a slow pace, you look for the frogs, insects, sleeping birds and night creatures that hide during the day.
highlights: Guided walk through the rainforest after dark
Night wildlife spotting with your guide
steps: Guided walk through the rainforest after dark
tours.bring: Closed shoes, long pants, insect repellent, a light rain jacket, camera.
